questions.question: What is the purpose of data curation in the ML pipeline?
choices: To collect as much raw data as possible without any filtering
To clean, filter, and select high-quality training data that improves model performance
To encrypt all training data for security compliance
To compress data into smaller file formats for storage savings
questions.explanation: Data curation is the process of filtering, cleaning, and selecting training data to ensure quality. The principle 'garbage in, garbage out' applies — better data consistently yields better models than more data.

questions.question: Why is deduplication an important step in data curation?
choices: Duplicate data makes the dataset take up less disk space
Duplicate entries bias the model toward over-represented patterns, wasting training compute and reducing diversity
Deduplication is only important for image datasets, not text
Duplicate data always improves model accuracy
questions.explanation: Duplicate data skews the model's learned distribution toward repeated patterns, effectively reducing the diversity of the training set. Removing duplicates ensures more uniform coverage of the data distribution.

questions.question: What does a quality scoring function with a sigmoid activation do in a data curation pipeline?
choices: It converts raw data into text format
It outputs a probability between 0 and 1 indicating how likely a data sample is to be high quality
It deletes low-quality data directly without human review
It doubles the size of the dataset
questions.explanation: A sigmoid function maps any input to a value between 0 and 1, making it ideal for binary classification — scoring each data sample as likely good (near 1) or likely bad (near 0) based on quality criteria.
